from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

# Inicializa Spark
spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("Job_dim_hour").getOrCreate()

# Caminho de saída no S3
output_path = "s3://alsimoes/empresas/ifood/gold/dim_hour.parquet"

#Criação da estrutura
hour = [
    (0, "00:00"),
    (1, "01:00"),
    (2, "02:00"),
    (3, "03:00"),
    (4, "04:00"),
    (5, "05:00"),
    (6, "06:00"),
    (7, "07:00"),
    (8, "08:00"),
    (9, "09:00"),
    (10, "10:00"),
    (11, "11:00"),
    (12, "12:00"),
    (13, "13:00"),
    (14, "14:00"),
    (15, "15:00"),
    (16, "16:00"),
    (17, "17:00"),
    (18, "18:00"),
    (19, "19:00"),
    (20, "20:00"),
    (21, "21:00"),
    (22, "22:00"),
    (23, "23:00"),
    (24, "24:00")
]

#Criação dimensão de mês
df_dim_hour = spark.createDataFrame(hour, ["id_hour", "ds_hour"])

# Escrita no S3 Silver
df_dim_hour.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(output_path)

print("Dimensão hora gerada com sucesso no caminho: " + output_path)
